title: Figure 8: Lightcraft Earth-to-orbit trajectory and associated pointing angles
description: Schematic (marked "Not to Scale") of a curved Earth with the "Sensible Atmosphere", a "Ground Based Laser" at "Lightcraft Launch", and the "Lightcraft Earth-to-Orbit Trajectory". Labels mark "End of Laser Airbreathing Propulsion", "End of Laser Rocket Propulsion", "Maximum (Cut-Off) Velocity" and the zenith/vertical. Caption: "Figure 8. Lightcraft Trajectory and Associated Pointing Angles [26]."
